about: O'Neill Library, Boston College. Format: docs/DATA_FORMAT.md. x, y are plan units, about 19.7 to a metre, in the frame of
Level 3 of the 2019 library floor map handout (the newer of the two maps; the 2013 map only fills gaps). All five levels were
lined up on that frame using the elevators and the round stairs. The map is drawn turned: its left is real NORTH, its top is
real EAST, and so is this file (about 14 degrees off). Compass words in names are REAL directions.
Room numbers and names come from the 2019 map. Names like "Office" or "Room 209" only have a number on the map ("useGuess": true).
Door positions, hallway lines, the walks through rooms and the aisles between the book stacks are guesses: check them on site.
